items.summary: Upstream #18 uses __builtin_amdgcn_wave_barrier() (scheduling barrier) as the __syncwarp() stand-in in migemm_neighmap_pp.cu:281-288, where lanes consume LDS written by other lanes. Correct on CDNA lockstep and wave64-correct indexing, but __threadfence_block() is the stronger form. Candidate one-line upstream PR; a person rules whether to pursue.

decided.note: No observed failure and no validated FlexGEMM port to test against; revisit if FlexGEMM is adopted as a TRELLIS.2 dependency and a wave32 card shows a real fault.
